🇮🇳 Facts About Punjab!
• Punjab is known as the “Land of Five Rivers”, referring to the Beas, Sutlej, Ravi, Chenab, and Jhelum. 🌊
• The Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib) in Amritsar is one of the most visited religious sites in the world. 🛕
